lines.label: Supplier screen-system kit
lines.rule: One package when kit supply is Yes; otherwise zero. Convert entered kit EUR cost to AUD and apply the kit margin.

lines.label: Standard screen cloth
lines.rule: Standard-screen count times cut length times cloth width, in square metres.

lines.label: Screen offcuts
lines.rule: When wider-sheet cutting is Yes, standard-screen count times cut length times the unused sheet width.

lines.label: Lengthwise cloth cutting
lines.rule: When wider-sheet cutting is Yes, offcut-screen count times cut length; this is cutting length, not cloth area.

lines.label: Additional screen cloth 1
lines.rule: Additional-screen slot 1: entered count times calculated cut length times entered width. Cut length rounds the shrinkage-adjusted base up to 0.1 m before adding two overhangs. Output selling rate incorrectly follows the main cloth.

lines.label: Additional screen cloth 2
lines.rule: Additional-screen slot 2: entered count times calculated cut length times entered width. Cut length rounds the shrinkage-adjusted base up to 0.1 m before adding two overhangs. Output selling rate incorrectly follows the main cloth.

lines.label: Additional screen cloth 3
lines.rule: Additional-screen slot 3: entered count times calculated cut length times entered width. Cut length rounds the shrinkage-adjusted base up to 0.1 m before adding two overhangs. Output selling rate incorrectly follows the main cloth.

lines.label: Additional screen cloth 4
lines.rule: Additional-screen slot 4: entered count times calculated cut length times entered width. Cut length rounds the shrinkage-adjusted base up to 0.1 m before adding two overhangs. Output selling rate incorrectly follows the main cloth.

lines.label: Additional screen cloth 5
lines.rule: Additional-screen slot 5: entered count times calculated cut length times entered width. Cut length rounds the shrinkage-adjusted base up to 0.1 m before adding two overhangs. Output selling rate incorrectly follows the main cloth.

lines.label: Additional cloth cutting
lines.rule: Additional cutting multipliers C85 and E85 multiplied together, when the first multiplier is positive.

lines.label: Additional cloth sewing
lines.rule: Additional sewing multipliers C86 and E86 multiplied together, when the first multiplier is positive.

lines.label: Solarweave edge seal 0.5 m by 100 m
lines.rule: If edge seals are selected, divide greenhouse length by 0.97, round that length to one decimal, multiply by twice the motors across, divide by 100 and round up to whole rolls.

lines.label: Edge-seal staples or old ABRI hooks
lines.rule: For normal edge seals, take the seal-roll count times two, divide by 0.2, add 10%, divide by 1,000 and round up to packs. This appears to use rolls where length may have been intended. The old ABRI alternative contains a broken reference.

lines.label: Double-sided tape 50 m
lines.rule: Use the entered number of 50 m tape rolls when double-sided tape is selected.

lines.label: LS Wire Black 2.2mm 1700m Roll
lines.rule: For the normal branch, divide physical width by 0.4, multiply by 1.5 and by length plus 2 m, add the spare percentage, divide by roll length, round up, then add one roll. It does not check replace LS wires. Old ABRI uses 0.5 m spacing and no roll division.

lines.label: Wire Black Coated 2.5mm (galv wire) on 1000m Roll
lines.rule: Add edge-wire count times edge-wire length, crosswire count times crosswire length and dropper wire. Add 15% and round up to a whole metre. The old ABRI description instead selects an M6 bolt, making its unit meaning inconsistent.

lines.label: Strainer #2 small Z/P
lines.rule: Crosswire strainers plus edge-wire strainers plus dropper strainers plus two spare strainers.

lines.label: LS Wire Crimp
lines.rule: Only when LS wires need replacement: bottom plus top LS-wire runs, add 5%, round up.

lines.label: Swage 3mm alum
lines.rule: Only Cable selects this line. Add four swages per drive drum, ten extra, two per bearing line, edge-wire and crosswire swages and dropper swages; add 2% and round up.

lines.label: Wire Clamp Alum PPA
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Wire clamp oval steel Z/P
lines.rule: With footy clamps selected, edge-wire runs times bays.

lines.label: Truss clips sized to chord height
lines.rule: For Truss Clip fastening, width divided by 0.4 times length divided by bay size, plus 20, rounded down.

lines.label: Truss clip screen folder or Crosswire Clip
lines.rule: For Truss Clip fastening, half the truss clips, rounded up. Otherwise, if crosswire clips are selected, use the crosswire-clip helper plus 5%, rounded up.

lines.label: Selected edge-wire plate
lines.rule: When edge-wire plates are selected, edge-wire runs times bays, rounded up.

lines.label: Selected end-beam RHS
lines.rule: When end beams are supplied, first divide span width by 8. Divide the calculation span count by that result, multiply by two, and round up. This inverse relationship is the surviving formula; confirm it before approving beam orders.

lines.label: Dropper RHS 50 by 50 by 8 m
lines.rule: When droppers are selected, divide total droppers by droppers cut per 8 m length and round up.

lines.label: Selected brace RHS
lines.rule: When braces are selected, brace length times two braces per span times calculation spans times two, divided by 6.5; round down and add one stock length. The description names 8 m stock, so the divisor needs review.

lines.label: Jack Chain 3mm GAL
lines.rule: When support chain is selected, entered chain per span times calculation spans times one fewer total screen, rounded down. Confirm the unusually large screen-count multiplier.

lines.label: Omega Bracket 50x50mm Internal
lines.rule: Internal bracket count per span times calculation spans times two, plus droppers plus two. A manual zero inclusion flag suppresses the line.

lines.label: Omega Bracket 50x50mm External
lines.rule: External bracket count per span times calculation spans times two, when that count is positive.

lines.label: Hex Bolt M8x65mm Z/P - High tensile Grade 8.8
lines.rule: When droppers exist, four bolts per dropper plus two.

lines.label: Nut M8 Z/P nyloc
lines.rule: When droppers exist, four nuts per dropper plus four.

lines.label: Washer Flat M8 Z/P
lines.rule: When droppers exist, eight washers per dropper plus four.

lines.label: Selected Edge Wire Omega Strip
lines.rule: When omega profile is needed, edge-wire runs times bays. Select 4 m strip for a 4 m bay, otherwise 6.4 m. Quantity bypasses the bed section gate.

lines.label: Grunt Baling Twine 500m
lines.rule: When baling twine is selected, add 20% to crosswire length times crosswire runs, divide by 500 and round up to rolls. Quantity bypasses the bed section gate.

lines.label: Drive Drum 4.0m  1" Drive one piece
lines.rule: The drive table uses total drives for Pinion, or one or two drums per drive for Cable according to pipe diameter. A manual zero flag suppresses output. The displayed description is itself manually fixed to a drum.

lines.label: Screen rack (White End) THG40 L=3.965m
lines.rule: Pinion uses one rack per drive; Cable uses one bearing per drive. Round up. A manual zero flag suppresses output. Rack selection uses an approximate bay-length lookup.

lines.label: Drive protector 25x3x300mm aluminium
lines.rule: Two drive protectors per included drive or drum at line 263.

lines.label: Asborg Clip S/S
lines.rule: Slow Pinion uses twice the drives less two clips; fast Pinion uses one bearing per rack. Cable uses drives times two for Central or one for End. A manual zero flag suppresses output.

lines.label: Slide Weld Coupling - Pinion - 1" Pipe
lines.rule: Slow Pinion uses twice the drives less twice the total motor count; fast Pinion uses zero. Cable uses drives divided by motors down, times bays, plus two. Wall pulleys add screen count times motors across times two. A manual zero flag suppresses output.

lines.label: Ultra Delay Block - Part B
lines.rule: One Part B for each Part A delay block at line 267, only when that exact Part A description is selected.

lines.label: Ultra Delay Block Part D
lines.rule: One Part D for each Part A delay block at line 267, only when that exact Part A description is selected.

lines.label: Connector 27mm for rack Z/P
lines.rule: Pinion uses two connectors per rack. Cable uses four grub screws per drum plus ten, or one or two turnbuckles per drive for End or Central. A manual zero flag suppresses output.

lines.label: Push-pull flanged nut
lines.rule: Only when the Pinion table selects flanged push-pull bolts, use the matching push-pull connector count for flanged nuts; otherwise zero.

lines.label: Flanged nut or selected slip spring
lines.rule: If the selected description is active, Cable uses twice the coupling count plus 20; Pinion uses twice the rack count plus two. Selection also checks old connector names and slip-clutch spring colour.

lines.label: Push-pull stock lengths
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Swaged Connector for 27mm push pull
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Pipe 25NB (1in) x2.6mmx6.5m galv ( Light )
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Roller push-pull 1 wheel Straight
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Screw tek 14 gauge 20mm fine galv
lines.rule: Pinion table: two screws per calculated roller plus included small strainers plus 50, with an alternate truss-clip branch. Cable: twice included drums plus strainers plus 50, with an alternate truss-clip branch. Add eight per internal omega bracket except VDH, and two per top and bottom LS run when extra teks are selected.

lines.label: Table Clamp 27mm
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Saddle Clamp 19mm Alum
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Bolt M6x75mm Hammerhead Z/P
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Nut M6 Z/P
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Nut M8 Z/P nyloc
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Washer Flat M6 Z/P for Cable
lines.rule: Cable uses the same count as its calculated M6 nyloc-nut table row; Pinion selects no washer and zero.

lines.label: CHS 19mmx1.2mmx6.1m Alum (L.Edge)
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Selected silicone strip for Ultralock
lines.rule: Profile only: selected leading-edge stock length times the manual leading-edge quantity, in metres.

lines.label: Insertion of Silicone Strip for Ultralock Profile
lines.rule: Profile only: same length as the silicone strip at line 286.

lines.label: LE tube Connector Alum 16mmx1.2 for 19mm
lines.rule: Leading-edge quantity plus ten joiners, except the old saw-cost description uses ten only. Joiner type follows profile, steel or aluminium.

lines.label: Pulley 50mm swivel single Z/P
lines.rule: For wall pulleys with a tube leading edge, motors across times eight, rounded down. An old connector-description branch instead doubles the joiner count.

lines.label: Screw TEK 10 gauge 16mm fine galv
lines.rule: Manual PPA wire-clamp quantity plus 10%, rounded down to whole screws.

lines.label: End cap for LE tube 19mm plast
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Roll Pin 26mm X 6mm
lines.rule: Explicit manual quantity; no surviving final quantity formula. Retain zero, reason and review basis separately.

lines.label: Selected push-pull delay unit
lines.rule: If delay units are selected, round length divided by 50 upward, subtract one and multiply by total drives. Diameter chooses the delay-unit description.

lines.label: Selected motor
lines.rule: Motors across times motors down. The motor section is off in this quote, so quantity is zero.

lines.label: Motor sprocket for 2 inch pipe
lines.rule: Two sprockets per included motor, only with 50 mm drive pipe.

lines.label: UNIVERSAL JOINT 120Nm
lines.rule: Use the entered universal-joint count when it is nonzero.

lines.label: COUPLING FOR UNIVERSAL 1"
lines.rule: Two couplings per included universal joint.

lines.label: Baseplate for GW Motors 163MM
lines.rule: One motor baseplate or VDH motor mount per included motor.

lines.label: Selected smart motor control box
lines.rule: One smart motor control box per motor when selected; description is taken from the selected motor catalogue row, column N, and requires checking.

lines.label: Gearbox 1:1 Tee alum
lines.rule: When wall gearboxes are selected, two gearboxes per motor across times motors down.

lines.label: Baseplate for Gearbox 1:1
lines.rule: One gearbox baseplate per gearbox. This quantity directly copies line 302 and bypasses its own line gate.

lines.label: Right-angle gearbox sprocket set or FFF placeholder
lines.rule: Two sprocket sets per gearbox baseplate. This quantity bypasses its own gate; the 25 mm description is the unresolved placeholder FFF.

lines.label: RHS 50x50x2.5mm 1.0m GALVABOND
lines.rule: One 1 m RHS support per included motor, if the motor-support choice is Yes.

lines.label: Bolt M10x90 Z/P All Thread
lines.rule: Four M10 bolts per included motor baseplate.

lines.label: Nut M10 Z/P Nyloc
lines.rule: Five M10 nyloc nuts per included motor baseplate.

lines.label: Washer Flat M10 Z/P
lines.rule: Thirteen M10 washers per included motor baseplate.

lines.label: Peg Plastic
lines.rule: Normal tube branch: width divided by 0.4 times length divided by bay size, add 10%, round down and use one peg per fixing. Profile doubles that multiplier and adds two pegs per 1.5 primary clips. Old ALUM and CLIP branches use different logic. Round final count up.

lines.label: Quad Clip Plastic
lines.rule: Normal branch: width divided by 0.4 plus four, times length divided by bay size, rounded down. Material selects Quad Clips or Ultra Slide Wire Guides. Old ABRI uses 0.5 m spacing and 10% allowance.

lines.label: Quad Clip Extra High S/S
lines.rule: Quad clips: width divided by 0.4 plus one, divided by two, times length divided by bay size, add 10% and round down. Power Clips use the primary clip count; Profile doubles the table result. The source does not visibly convert the profile description of 250 per pack to packs.

lines.label: Weight washers or no weight fitting
lines.rule: Weights or Blackout: round screen width down to whole metres, add one, then multiply by screen count, four and two. Hooks select no weight line. An old ABRI option is retained in the lookup.

lines.label: Weight Disc Pin Plastic
lines.formula: =IF(A314="Washer to replace weightdisc for cloth 6mm hole",C314/2,0)
lines.rule: One plastic pin for every two weight washers. Quantity directly follows line 314 and bypasses its own line gate.

lines.label: LE UltraProfile Clothfinger Black
lines.rule: For Profile, use the manual cloth-catch or end-cap count from line 291.

lines.label: Edge Hook Clamp
lines.rule: For Hooks, Weights and Blackout, screen count times rounded-up hooks per edge times two, add 10%, round down. Blackout selects a two-piece hook; Hooks and Weights select a hook clamp. Old ABRI uses a separate 0.4 m calculation.

quality.title: Pinion tube and drive pipe diameters are separate fields
quality.detail: §9 lists 25 | 32 | 50 against C99. The r02 register, the legacy validation lists and TABLES!J40:J41 place 27 | 32 at C99 and 25 | 32 | 50 at C102 (Drive Pipe Diameter). r03 keeps both identities.

quality.title: Cloth width lookup rows disagree inside the extract
quality.detail: §1 and §7 list five bay sizes; §8 lists six including 5 m → 5.3 m. r02 already implemented six rows; r03 retains them.

quality.title: §14 coverage is an abridged extract
quality.detail: §14 lists 16 of 142 fields and omits the observed 15-bay value. The r03 coverage view uses the full TEST_CASES comparison.

quality.title: §15 count and one row are inconsistent
quality.detail: The text says 21 of 29 choice fields; the table has 19 rows. The drive pipe diameter row contradicts TEST_CASES. Baling twine No is missing.

quality.title: Two catalogue descriptions look altered
quality.detail: "Connector Endmm for rack Z/P" and "Table Clamp Endmm" appear to be "27mm" descriptions changed by a text replacement.

quality.title: Cable location list wording differs
quality.detail: §2 lists End | Middle. The r02 register and the source table list Central | End. r03 keeps Central | End.

quality.title: Some Pinion drive-table parts differ from r02 positions
quality.detail: Positions 264, 266, 267 and 274 name different parts in r02 and in the r04 drive table. r03 shows a conflict instead of choosing.

quality.title: Catalogue prices are not published
quality.detail: The extract carries indicative and placeholder cost and sell values. r03 keeps SYN-PRICE-02 position rates and embeds no catalogue prices.

quality.title: A parameter label does not match its use
quality.detail: cable_size_band_1 is labelled a 100 mm threshold; the source uses 100 as the Nm result of the first Cable torque band.

quality.title: Truss chord height has seven recovered values
quality.detail: §1 lists 25 | 30 | 50 for truss_cord_height_mm. The legacy validation at G30 lists 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50 and 60. r03 offers the recovered list; the truss clip part exists only for 30 and 50.

quality.title: Pinion catalogue rows were read from a Cable quote
quality.detail: The drive table in the extract was cached with Cable selected. Pinion descriptions that depend on speed or drive pipe (push-pull 1:1 versus 1:1.8, slide-weld couplings) therefore differ from what a Pinion quote would show. r03 applies the recovered formulas and marks the missing descriptions as not in the catalogue.

quality.title: Ultra Groove drum is formula-driven
quality.detail: G95 is IF(drive = Cable, Yes, N/A), so the 2-inch drum rule always selects the Ultra Groove drum for Cable. No control is exposed; the formula is applied.
